mapper.select: SELECT sc.cart_code, sc.user_code, sc.game_code, sc.cart_date, g.game_title, g.game_price, g.game_sale_price, g.game_main_image FROM gemdori_shopping_cart_tbl sc JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON sc.game_code = g.game_code WHERE sc.user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY sc.cart_date DESC /* 최근에 담은 순서로 정렬 (선택 사항) */
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gemdori_shopping_cart_tbl ( cart_code, user_code, game_code, cart_date ) VALUES ( #{cartCode}, #{userCode}, #{gameCode}, SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM gemdori_shopping_cart_tbl WHERE user_code = #{userCode} AND game_code = #{gameCode}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN g.game_sale_price IS NOT NULL AND g.game_sale_price > 0 THEN g.game_sale_price ELSE g.game_price END ) as total_amount FROM gemdori_shopping_cart_tbl sc JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON sc.game_code = g.game_code WHERE sc.user_code = #{userCode}

SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN g.game_sale_price IS NOT NULL AND g.game_sale_price > 0 THEN (g.game_price - g.game_sale_price) ELSE 0 END ) as discount_amount FROM gemdori_shopping_cart_tbl sc JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON sc.game_code = g.game_code WHERE sc.user_code = #{userCode}
